text:
Asha: Quick heads-up — planning to land rfc-logging tomorrow in the 10:30-11:00 PT release slot. It touches infra logging + rollout hooks. Need a smoke owner + rollback lead. Anyone available?
Liam: I can own smoke tests. Will run integration smoke + log sanity. Ping me when slot opens.
Priya: I'll be rollback lead. If anything looks off, I can revert and pin previous artifact.
Asha: Thanks — two asks: confirm CI is green and approve canary strategy. Thinking 10% for 15m. Is 10% okay?
Marcos: 10% sounds fine. Also please add short smoke steps: tail logs, check error rate < 0.5%, sample the event pipeline.
Asha: Adding steps to the checklist: ```sh
# pseudo-smoke commands
smoke.sh --env=staging --tail=cloudwatch --check-errors=0.5%
``` CI status: lint ✅, unit tests ✅, e2e is flaky but gated behind smoke.
Liam: I'll run smoke at T+5 and T+20 minutes into canary and post results here. @deploy-bot can you reserve the slot and post the deploy command?
deploy-bot: Slot reserved for 10:30 PT. Deploy command prepared: ```
deployctl run --service=rfc-logging --tag=sha-abc123 --canary=10% --monitor=15m
``` :white_check_mark:
Jules: Code review merged, two tiny comments addressed. No DB migrations. Good to proceed.
Priya: Rollback plan: previous pinned tag is sha-xyz789. If smoke or telemetry shows regressions, I'll run: `deployctl rollback --service=rfc-logging --to=sha-xyz789` — I'll be on call 10:20-11:00.
Asha: Final checklist: CI green, CR merged, smoke owner = Liam, rollback = Priya, canary 10% x15m, monitor errors + latency. If smoke fails -> rollback immediately. Any objections?
Marcos: No objections. I'll watch telemetry for error spikes and latency.
Liam: Will capture a short runbook during smoke and paste commands/results here after each check.
Asha: Thanks — @deploy-bot please schedule a channel reminder 10 minutes before slot.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at 10:20 PT for #eng-releases. Good luck! :rocket:
